title: Local ZAP start and run start truth
goal: Fix the local active-web startup path where approving and starting a ZAP-backed mission can appear to do nothing because the local ZAP readiness script can hang on an unreachable daemon and started runs do not record a started_at timestamp when the runner actually begins.
scope: Live operator report 2026-05-03: after creating a mission, approving it, and pressing Start, the run stayed in running/cancelling with no visible progress. Runtime diagnosis showed TASK_DISPATCH_MODE=inline, ZAP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080, no ZAP daemon initially reachable, no ZAP/java process, two ZAP tasks stuck as running without tool_executions, and scripts/ensure_local_zap_daemon.sh hanging on its initial curl because it had no bounded connect/max timeout.
generation_reason: A mission lifecycle defect made Start look inert for local ZAP-backed active web runs; the repo needs a bounded local ZAP readiness check and truthful started_at state when a runner starts.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only fix bounded local ZAP readiness and truthful run started_at state when existing runners start. Do not redesign dispatch, add new live target actions, change pack registry behavior, or bypass approval/scope gates.

success_criteria: scripts/ensure_local_zap_daemon.sh does not hang indefinitely when the configured ZAP endpoint is unreachable.
A run records started_at when process_task_by_id transitions the attached run to running.
Inline ZAP dispatch tests still complete against the fake ZAP server.
The fix does not execute live customer or intrusive targets.
must_not_touch: Pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding gates
Live target execution beyond local health/readiness checks

acceptance_criteria: Bounded unreachable-ZAP readiness check returns quickly instead of hanging.
Inline ZAP fake-server dispatch records run.started_at and completes.
Local live ZAP daemon is reachable after operational start.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Force-cancelling already stale running tasks without an existing governed recovery path
Running a new external target assessment
